subject: Request: Marketplace credit exception for RetailPulse SMB bundle
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@retailpulse.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureTeam <procure@retailpulse.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace credit request for SMB bundle

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. RetailPulse is excited about Redwood's latency profile for short-chat workflows — team loved the demo. We are finalizing procurement but running into internal budget carve-outs for marketplace purchases.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a marketplace listing credit or promotional concession so we can accept a private offer via AWS Marketplace instead of direct invoicing? The volume estimate is modest in year 1 (approx $60k list value across 12 months), but we expect to expand if performance and latency hold. Procurement is asking for a one-time marketplace discount (or credit) to offset onboarding fees so the deal can close this quarter.

Attached is our expected usage profile and procurement template. We are on a tight timeline — would appreciate a response by Friday EOD PT.

Attachments: retailpulse_MA_plan.pdf (summary), procurement_template.docx (procurement form)

Best,
Sophie Grant
Head of Platform Partnerships
RetailPulse
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace credit request for SMB bundle

Hi Ben/Marissa,

Looping you in — RetailPulse (Sophie) has asked for a marketplace listing credit to accept an AWS private offer. Deal: ~$60k first-year list, strategic SMB retail customer; potential expansion into co-sell. Procurement wants a one-time concession to cover onboarding.

Key asks:
- Can Deal Desk approve a credit applied to the marketplace listing (so they can accept private offer terms)?
- If not, what alternatives (co-sell uplift, marketing credit, or a 1-off invoice credit) are permissible?

I attached their usage summary and a quick pricing model I sketched (pricing-model.xlsx). Also included HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DP-98765

Timing: they need confirmation by Fri EOD PT.

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (proposed concession scenarios)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace credit request for SMB bundle

Vanessa — thanks for the context. A few thoughts/questions:

1) Economics: $60k list is small but acceptable if we protect unit economics. Can you confirm expected avg tokens / month and whether embeddings are in scope? I modeled a conservative 20% gross margin hit if we give a 15% listing credit.
2) Ask: propose either (A) 10% marketplace listing credit applied up-front plus $10k co-sell marketing credit, or (B) 15% listing credit and no marketing credit. Option A preserves better upsell incentives.
3) Approval path: I can approve up to 10% from sales side; anything beyond needs Marissa/Deal Desk sign-off. Also need Finance sign-off for any accounting treatment on marketplace credits.

I recommend we get a short business justification from Sophie (use-case expansion, 12-month forecast, contact for renewal) and then present to Deal Desk with the proposed option and modeling.

I cc'ed finance_help@redwood.com to get early visibility.

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, finance_help@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketplace credit request for SMB bundle

Thanks for the notes. I support a constrained concession to win and keep the economics intact. Approve Option A with conditions:

- 10% marketplace listing credit (applied to initial 12-month private offer)
- $10k co-sell marketing credit (to be delivered as MDF/marketing services)
- Renewal guardrail: if usage < 50% forecast at 9 months, credit clawback or no further concessions for renewal.
- Require a short customer commitment letter (1-page) confirming 12-month forecast and expansion intent.

Finance: please confirm accounting treatment for the listing credit (recognition impact) and approval for the $10k MDF. If finance flags issues, escalate back to me.

Vanessa: you can communicate approval to Sophie once finance confirms. Also please upload signed commitment and final pricing into HubSpot and attach DocuSign link for private offer.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@retailpulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ProcureTeam <procure@retailpulse.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2024 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace credit request for SMB bundle — approved next steps

Hi Sophie,

Good news — we can proceed. Redwood will approve the following one-time concession to enable a private offer through AWS Marketplace:

- 10% marketplace listing credit applied to the first 12 months of the private offer (applies to list price only).
- $10,000 co-sell marketing credit to support joint launch activities (to be paid as MDF / marketing services).

Conditions:
- RetailPulse signs a 12-month commitment letter confirming the forecast and expansion intent (we will provide a one-page template).
- If usage at month 9 is under 50% of forecast, Redwood reserves the right to claw back unearned credits or withhold future concessions.

Next steps:
1) I am attaching the commitment letter template and our final pricing model (pricing-model.xlsx).
2) Please review and return the signed commitment to procure@redwood.com.
3) We will send a DocuSign private-offer packet (link below) that matches the concession above. Once signed, Redwood will provision the marketplace private offer for acceptance.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-rp-offer
Attachments: retailpulse_MA_plan.pdf, pricing-model.xlsx, docusign-RP-offer.pdf

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to run through the template.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0148
